ai-cli: Claude Code cloud sessions now bundle `gh api`, fixing GitHub workflows that lacked the CLI.
ai-infra: llama.cpp adds Ling 3.0 JSON-schema support and OpenVINO 2026.4.1, broadening structured local inference.
ai-trending: Agent-Reach gives agents one CLI for searching and reading X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and Xiaohongshu.
Caveman compresses coding-agent interactions, claiming 65% lower token use through terser output.
ai-hn: Pi pod runs Pi coding agents in sandboxes on your own server, keeping agent execution self-hosted and isolated.
Offrun centralizes multiple coding agents and development environments in one workspace for easier orchestration.
ai-community: AI reviewer agents can approve a permanently ineffective test, so independent adversarial review remains necessary.
Agent timeouts can hide completed side effects, requiring idempotency, request IDs and status reconciliation.
